title: betula pumila subsp. glandulifera
intro: Betula pumila subsp. glandulifera, commonly known as the dwarf birch, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Betulaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects that contribute to various health benefits such as soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Betula pumila subsp. glandulifera include acting as an astringent, an anti-inflammatory, and an antimicrobial agent, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including betulin, betulinic acid, and other triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to possess potential therapeutic benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
